question: In the context of the Panchayati Raj system in India, what does the term 'Village Panchayat' refer to?

options.text: Local government at the village level

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Local government at the village level**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Village Panchayat** is the **grassroots-level institution** of the Panchayati Raj system in India.
 
• It is a part of the **three-tier system** of rural local governance which includes the **Village Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti** (block level), and **Zila Parishad** (district level).
